economy.summary: His campaign says he is committed to strengthening the economy and supporting small business development, citing his 30 years as owner of Breski Beverage.
economy.short: Says he supports strengthening economy and small business development.

taxes.summary: His campaign lists holding the line on taxes as a stated priority.
taxes.short: Says holding the line on taxes is a priority.

abortion.summary: Voted in July 2022 for Senate Bill 106, a proposed package of state constitutional amendments including a provision stating there is no constitutional right to taxpayer-funded abortion or other right relating to abortion.
abortion.short: Voted for 2022 amendment package including no-abortion-right provision.

education.summary: Was one of three Republicans who voted in June 2026 for a Democratic-sponsored bill requiring scholarship organizations in Pennsylvania's $680 million school-choice tax credit programs to disclose more information to the state about how funds are distributed.
education.short: Voted for added disclosure rules on school-choice tax credits.

healthcare.summary: His campaign says he authored the Patient Safety Act, which would establish safe patient limits in hospitals and allow nurses time for comprehensive patient assessments.
healthcare.short: Authored Patient Safety Act setting hospital patient limits for nurses.

energy.summary: Co-chairs the General Assembly's bipartisan Nuclear Energy Caucus and supports the restart of Three Mile Island; he sponsored legislation to credit nuclear power under the state's Alternative Energy Portfolio Standards and has introduced a bill to increase operator fees to enhance nuclear plant inspections.
energy.short: Supports nuclear power, Three Mile Island restart; co-chairs nuclear caucus.

guns.summary: His campaign says that as a gun owner he has supported legislation preserving gun rights and defending the Second Amendment.
guns.short: Says he supported legislation preserving gun rights, Second Amendment.

economy.summary: Her campaign cites rising costs, including climbing property taxes, more expensive groceries, unpredictable gas prices, and growing utility bills, along with a stagnant minimum wage, as central challenges making it harder for district families to keep up.
economy.short: Cites rising costs and stagnant minimum wage as central challenge.

abortion.summary: In a 2024 iVoterGuide candidate questionnaire, said abortion should be permitted for severe fetal anomalies, threats to maternal health or life, rape, incest, and any other condition decided between the doctor and mother, and opposed defunding Planned Parenthood.
abortion.short: Supports abortion access decided between doctor and mother.

healthcare.summary: In a 2024 iVoterGuide candidate questionnaire, favored government-funded insurance available to all alongside private insurance options, and supported vaccination requirements in settings where an unvaccinated person could spread illness.
healthcare.short: Favors public insurance option alongside private plans.

energy.summary: In a 2024 iVoterGuide candidate questionnaire, supported stricter environmental laws and action on climate, and identified sun, wind, water, and nuclear energy as reliable electricity sources.
energy.short: Supports stricter environmental laws; backs solar, wind, water, nuclear.

guns.summary: In a 2024 iVoterGuide candidate questionnaire, supported prohibiting ghost guns, high-capacity magazines, and military-style assault weapons, expanding background checks, and removing firearms from at-risk individuals, and opposed allowing teachers to carry guns in schools.
guns.short: Supports assault-weapons ban, expanded background checks; opposes armed teachers.
